title: Latent Diffusion for Internet of Things Attack Data Generation in Intrusion Detection
abstract: arXiv:2601.16976v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The growing deployment of IoT systems has increased the need for reliable intrusion detection under heterogeneous and imbalanced network traffic. However, representative malicious traffic, particularly for underrepresented attacks, remains difficult to obtain, while existing generative approaches do not consistently preserve distributional fidelity, multivariate dependencies, and coverage simultaneously. This work proposes LaDIS, an attack-specific framework that learns a mixed-type autoencoder representation and performs diffusion in an adaptive continuous latent space. LaDIS was compared with established adversarial, variational, and direct-space diffusion approaches across representative Flooding, Botnet, Recon, and Stealthy attacks using complementary measures of marginal and multivariate fidelity, dependency preservation, real--synthetic distinguishability, manifold structure, and computational efficiency. translated_title: 面向入侵检测中物联网攻击数据生成的潜在扩散方法
translated_abstract: 随着物联网系统部署的不断增长，在异构且不平衡的网络流量环境下进行可靠入侵检测的需求日益增加。然而，具有代表性的恶意流量——尤其是代表性不足的攻击类型——仍然难以获取，而现有的生成方法无法同时稳定地保持分布保真度、多变量依赖关系和覆盖度。本工作提出了LaDIS，一个针对攻击数据专用的框架，该框架学习混合类型的自编码器潜在表示，并在自适应的连续潜在空间中执行扩散过程。研究采用互补的评估指标，包括边缘分布与多变量分布的保真度、依赖关系保持、真实与合成数据的可区分性、流形结构以及计算效率，将LaDIS与成熟的对抗式、变分式和直接空间扩散方法进行了比较，涵盖代表性的洪泛、僵尸网络、侦察和隐蔽攻击。LaDIS提供了compe...（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出LaDIS框架，通过学习混合类型自编码器表示并在自适应连续潜在空间中执行扩散，为物联网入侵检测生成保真度高、保持多变量依赖且覆盖度好的攻击数据，尤其在代表性不足的攻击类型上优于对抗式、变分式和直接空间扩散等现有生成方法。
en_tdlr: LaDIS is an attack-specific latent diffusion framework that learns a mixed-type autoencoder representation and performs diffusion in an adaptive continuous latent space to generate high-fidelity IoT attack data with preserved multivariate dependencies and coverage, outperforming established adversarial, variational, and direct-space diffusion approaches for intrusion detection.
